Crypto prices rose after uncertainty followed a delayed US tariff ruling.

Bitcoin and major altcoins climbed after markets reacted to delays in a US Supreme Court decision on tariffs, easing near-term policy anxiety. Traders viewed the pause as reducing immediate downside risk for risk assets. Analysts noted the rally was sentiment-driven rather than tied to fundamentals. Volatility remained elevated as markets awaited clearer legal and policy signals.

'RELEASE CHANTAL ANICOCHE': In New York City, Filipino-Americans held a protest at the Philippine Consulate to demand the release of youth activist Chantal Anicoche, who is currently under the custody of the 203rd Infantry Brigade of the Armed Forces of the Philippines.

The 25-year old youth activist was reported missing on January 1 during the military aerial bombings and strafing in Barangay Cabacao, Abra de Ilog, Occidental Mindoro. 

BAYAN-USA described Anicoche as a "beloved Filipino community member and leader."

“As long as our people are poor, as long as our people remain landless, as long as our people are forced to go overseas only to be exploited further, there will only be more Chantals who will continue to resist in the belly of the beast and those who choose to go back home to fight alongside our people to achieve genuine freedom and democracy," said Winnie Payabyab of BAYAN USA Northeast.

Para di ka na mahirapan, ito ang breakdown mga repa:

1. User and Network Growth:
Viction nakapag-record ng 59% YoY growth sa MAU, 411% growth sa TVL, at peak ng 63K DAU at 170K MAU, kabilang sa top 8 fastest-growing chains.

2. Peak activity during Retrodrop Season 3:
Viction naging #1 sa WAU (+90% WoW) at ranked #15 sa EVM chains, with 78% MoM increase sa Monthly Active Wallets mula Sept hanggang Oct.

3. Core Infrastructure:
Viction nag-launch ng zero-gas Layer-1 at Atlas Hard Fork noong August, nag-improve sa Layer-1 foundation for scaling ecosystem growth.

4.Ecosystem:
Viction naging multi-vertical ecosystem na may 150+ projects sa DeFi, GameFi, NFTs, at Infra, supported ng mga partners tulad ng @graphprotocol, @nansen_ai, at @SafePal.

5. Community at Scale:
Ang community ng Viction, pinangunahan ng @Frontier_DAO, ay may local chapters sa iba’t ibang lugar, diverse collaborations, at Viction Vanguard Program na may 800+ contributors at 200+ monthly submissions.

6. Offline Activation at Conviction Conference:
Ang offline activation ng Viction City sa @Convictionvn nag-resulta sa +35% social media impressions at +75% engagement during the event.

Ngayong 2026:

Sa 2026, mag-focus ang Viction sa pag-scale ng Ownership Economy gamit ang mas matibay na protocols, infrastructure, partnerships, at real-world utility applications.
